From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 22 Sep 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Stage triage + closeproof roadcheck (EOW)

Team —

Quick pre-weekend roadcheck on stage hygiene and closeproof for a handful of at-risk/opportunity-critical deals. Finance asked us for a cleaned-up forecast snapshot by Monday morning; if we want anything to show as commit in next week's numbers we need to be firm by EOW Thursday.

Please do the following by EOD Thursday (9/28):
- Update SFDC stage to the most accurate single value (no "Negotiation/Review" + "Commit" both set).
- If a PO/contract is expected but not signed, set close date to the date you can reasonably prove (attach evidence).
- If a deal is drifting with no activity >45d, either reclassify to "No Decision" or move to nurture (archive).
- Add a short note on the opportunity timeline and the next concrete milestone (one line).

I've attached a short triage playbook and a quick filter you can run in SF to pull your candidate list. I'm tracking two priority IDs below for reference: ACME-001 (Acme Health) and SOL-42 (Solaris).

Attachments: triage-playbook.pdf (playbook), pipeline-snapshot.xlsx (filter + sample output).

Call out if you need me to step into a customer convo to lock dates. Thanks — small, fast moves here will save a reforecast.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior AE, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
